trades.name: Fail of today's spike 29517-29538
trades.quote: While far less clean than for ES, I’m willing to short persistent fails to bid today’s spike, inclusive of the base (517) and today’s 538 high. I’ll rate this a B-

trades.name: Hold of 29420-29441
trades.quote: Long a hold of 420-441, possibly as high as 452-458 is a B+

trades.name: True gap up holding today's spike
trades.quote: Long a true gap up which holds today’s spike from above feels a bit risky but given the potential for 706-735 I’ll still rate it a B/B-

trades.name: LBAF of today's low
trades.quote: Long a LBAF of today’s low is a tad risky as well but 338-369 is super key. In this scenario a reclaim of 390 becomes key and we have to be worried about 420-441 (potentially 452-458) from below so I can’t rate it higher than a B/B-

trades.name: LBAF of today's low reclaiming 7677-7680
